R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  color=grid[r][c]
  if color and color!=2 and (r,c) not in seen:
   stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
   while stack:
    x,y=stack.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
    for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
     p=(x+dx,y+dy)
     if 0<=p[0]<R and 0<=p[1]<C and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==color and p not in seen:
      seen.add(p); stack.append(p)
   comps.append((color,cells))
